::: {#def-relation-matrix}
#### Matrix of a relation

Let $R$ be a relation from a finite set $A$ to a finite set $B$ (@def-finite-set),
and list their elements in a chosen order as $A = \set{a_1, \ldots, a_m}$ and $B = \set{b_1, \ldots, b_n}$.
The **matrix** of $R$ [@wikipedia_logical_matrix] is the $m \times n$ matrix (@def-matrix) $M_R$
whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$ is

$$
m_{ij} \eqdef
\begin{cases}
1 & \text{if } (a_i, b_j) \in R,
\\
0 & \text{if } (a_i, b_j) \notin R.
\end{cases}
$$

For a relation on a set $A$, the rows and the columns list $A$ in the same order.

:::
